title: Add activity log amount formatting metadata
summary: Amount fields in the Expense Activity Log Entry table now include currency-aware formatting metadata to display local currency and reimbursement currency values correctly.
key_points: LCY amount fields apply local-currency formatting
Reimbursable and refundable amount fields use stored reimbursement currency formatting
API decimal values and snapshot behavior remain unchanged
Metadata addition for improved display of financial amounts
quote: Add currency-aware display metadata to the Expense Activity Log Entry amount snapshots.
